business_summary: Rikei Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the system and network solutions, and electronic components and instrument businesses in Japan. It provides system solutions, including IT infrastructure, information security, and 3D CAD, CAM, and CAE solutions; PCs for corporations; IBM; Hewlett Packard enterprise solutions; entrance exam/curriculum and secure file collaboration systems; non-contact vital measurement and cloud SaaS solutions; IoT products; cloud authentication solution; software for power systems EMT simulations and calculating cable current carrying capacity; application for preventing medication errors; integrated internet marketing systems; and AI products to private companies, universities, government offices, and research institutions. The company also offers information transmission and distribution network solutions to satellite communications and broadcasting transmission systems, and various disaster prevention information transmission systems for local governments; and electronic components, instruments, and electronic materials for various sectors, including industrial equipment, automobile, medical, optical communication, and security. In addition, it engages in the sale and lease of aircraft and aircraft parts, and customer support; system development activities; and export, import, and sale of electronic components, including optical communication devices, semiconductors, microwave communication equipment components, Power supplies, conductive resin adhesives, LCD panels, touch panels, various sensors, and other various electronic components and equipment, PFAS adsorption, Ion exchange resins, disaster relief equipment, security equipment, VR/MR flight simulators, ultra-high resolution VR/AR headsets, and integrated circuits. The company was formerly known as Rikei Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Rikei Corporation in June 1971. Rikei Corporation was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

IT 인프라, 정보 보안, 3D CAD, CAM, CAE 솔루션을 포함한 시스템 솔루션을 제공합니다. 기업용 PC; IBM; Hewlett Packard 엔터프라이즈 솔루션; 입학 시험/커리큘럼 및 보안 파일 협업 시스템; 비접촉 필수 측정 및 클라우드 SaaS 솔루션; IoT 제품; 클라우드 인증 솔루션; 전력 시스템 EMT 시뮬레이션 및 케이블 전류 운반 용량 계산을 위한 소프트웨어; 투약 오류 예방을 위한 신청; 통합 인터넷 마케팅 시스템; AI 제품을 민간기업, 대학, 관공서, 연구기관에 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 이 회사는 위성 통신 및 방송 전송 시스템에 대한 정보 전송 및 배포 네트워크 솔루션과 지방 정부를 위한 다양한 방재 정보 전송 시스템을 제공합니다. 산업장비, 자동차, 의료, 광통신, 보안 등 다양한 분야의 전자부품, 계측기, 전자재료 등을 생산하고 있습니다. 에서
